caption: The drawing features a single brass candlestick centered on a plain, light beige background. The candlestick has a circular holder at the top with a central recess for a candle, supported by a round, vertically-ridged shaft. The shaft transitions into a square base with stepped edges and beveled corners, providing a stable foundation. The entire object is rendered in shades of gold and yellow with subtle shadows and highlights, giving a metallic appearance, and it is depicted at a three-quarter angle. A thin, rectangular border outlines the picture, and there is a handwritten signature in the bottom right corner within the border. There are no other objects or decorative elements present in the composition.
title: Candlestick
